bootstrap.draws: numpy default_rng(0).integers(0, n, (4000, n)) over the sorted groups
bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%; fits, multipliers and decisions fixed; all designs of a group travel together
bootstrap.scope: Identity sampling only. The year analysis has 2 independent time blocks; the rolling analysis has 6 half-year blocks from 6 origins on one timeline. The number of blocks is written under every table.

independent_time_blocks.note: identity bootstrap expresses identity sampling; blocks are not resampled

rule: full (AnchorBoost slot, alpha = 1), one_se (the alpha-scaled AnchorBoost of choices.json), measured_only and interpolation: crc_obs of risk_upgrade amendment 004 as written in scale_A amendment 001. A design with measured_only >= 3 is released with call active (0); any other design is released iff its exact margin > lambda; lambda is the first grid value of -1, 0, 0.01, ..., 1 with (sum_g L_g + 1)/(n_cal + 1) <= 1/10 for L_g(lambda) = (1/D_g) * sum over the group designs with measured_only < 3 of 1(margin > lambda) 1(call != truth); exact rational arithmetic; lambda = 1 when no grid value qualifies (lane designs are still released).
